title: Allergic reaction
whenToUse: A skin rash after exposure, or sudden breathing trouble or swelling.

steps.text: Move away from the trigger right away if you know what caused it.
Check for breathing trouble, throat tightness, lip swelling, or dizziness.
If severe, inject your epinephrine auto-injector firmly into your outer thigh.
steps.detail: Hold against your outer thigh as directed on the device. About 7 to 18 percent of people need a second dose if symptoms continue.

steps.text: Alert a crewmate right away after using epinephrine.

redFlags: You have trouble breathing or swallowing.
Your throat feels tight or your voice changes.
Your lips, tongue or face are swelling.
You feel dizzy or about to faint.

escalation.text: Red flag or getting worse? Alert a crewmate now. Do not wait for Earth.
